title: AW_avatar
description: The `AW_avatar` extension on the glTF root.

nodes.description: One entry per glTF node, in node order.

materials.description: One entry per glTF material, in material order.

skeleton.description: The source's rest pose as given.

MuscleLimit.description: Degrees; absent on a bone that uses Unity's default limits.

Visemes.description: Blendshape names, in VRChat's viseme order.

materials.description:
The renderer's material slots, in slot order. A mesh shared by several renderers keeps
its own primitive materials as the generic viewer's fallback.

active.description: After evaluating every playable layer's default state at time 0.

renderQueue.description: The render state the shader pass resolves from its properties.

blend.description: Absent for opaque and cut-out materials.

node.description: The node the component sits on.

spring.description: Called momentum under the advanced integration type.

Curved.description: A VRChat field with its optional curve over the chain.

Permission.description: Who may collide with, grab or pose a component.

node.description: The node the component sits on.

Channel.description: At-rest and offset values with the axes the constraint affects.

ParameterValue.description: The variant is the parameter's type.

oneOf.description: Labels are up, right, down, left.
Sub-parameters and labels are up, right, down, left.

controller.description: Absent when the avatar uses VRChat's default controller for this layer.

AnimatorParameterValue.description: The variant is the parameter's type.

bodyParts.description: Humanoid body parts the mask lets through.

transforms.description: Transforms the mask names, each let through or not.

oneOf.description:
Runs the state machine of the layer at index `layer` with this layer's own motion and
behaviours for each state it lists.

stateMachineTransitions.description: Transitions from this machine's exit node, which Unity keeps on its parent.

StateId.description: Unique among the states of one controller.

oneOf.description: A fraction of the source state's length.
A bool destination uses `chance`; int and float destinations draw from `min..=max`.
`property` is the shader property, with `.r`/`.x`-style component suffixes as Unity binds them.
Unity's humanoid muscle or root curve name.

ContactIndex.description: Into the senders or the receivers, as the binding names.

SlotCurve.description: A material swap: which material fills a renderer's slot over time.
